svg.aria-label: The field: a discipline as one disc of concepts, dense and proven at the center, sparse and unproven at the edge, in three sectors
svg.title: The field: a discipline as one disc of concepts, dense and proven at the center, sparse and unproven at the edge, in three sectors
svg.text: the machine is no better here
Filled: proven. Hollow: accepted, not proven. Lighter: contested. Size: how much depends on it.
Dashed: not written yet. Barred: not provable from inside. Hatched: dense, but nothing grades an answer.
